lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Umar is dead. Bad business. I walk the lanes after dark and see more than most. Nothing I'll name yet. Elsie, you were quick to say nothing at Dusk. Why? Rosa, same question. Speak up, both of you. Silence looks like guilt to me.

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Umar's death is a loss, and we should weigh evidence, not gossip. Three points. First, Tess, a buttoned coat is a tailoring remark, not a clue. Second, Silas asked fair questions, but silence at Dusk proves little. Third, Pia is right that the loud voices should not carry the day. I will hold my suspicions until we have facts. Who saw Umar last, and where?

lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Tess, a tailor's eye for buttons is a cheap shot, and you're the loudest against me. Funny how that works. I walk the lanes after dark and I saw nothing that points at Hugo. Hugo talks sense. Luna, you asked him where he was. Answer for yourself too. Stop chasing coats and watch who pushes hardest.

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Let's weigh evidence, not coats. Tess accused Silas and Rosa in one breath, yet offers no proof. Rosa dodged Silas's question with flour on her hands. Luna demanded my whereabouts but gave none of her own. Elsie praises listening but names no one. I was at my hearth, alone, and I'll answer anything plainly. Watch who never answers.
